ideas.title: Minnesota's Handling of Fraud Warnings
ideas.description: Investigate the state's handling of fraud warnings and allegations of incompetence
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the timeline of events
questions: What were the specific fraud warnings ignored by Minnesota officials?
How much money was lost due to the alleged incompetence?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold officials accountable for their actions. By following the money and tracking the timeline of events, we can determine the extent of the issue and identify areas for improvement.
